objective: Add a versioned descriptive raw-quality summary and a per-OID JSON export that preserves the complete native DR24 response and records that no quality mask or epoch exclusion was applied.
previous_knowledge_consumed: The seven-OID raw Workbench smoke passed for 2183 epochs against the hardened adapter.
Missing catflags must be treated as unknown, not as zero or clean.
Negative magerr values are preserved; no production exclusion rule has been approved.
The raw Explorer must not convert HMJD, apply color correction, group OIDs, or run the frozen v0.2.0 model.

baseline.revision: PR #272 seven-OID branch with hardened PR #264 adapter
baseline.description: Raw-only DR24 Explorer; frozen v0.2.0 model and feature contract unchanged.

correctness.before: The UI displayed raw values and bit-15 markers, but it did not expose a versioned descriptive QC summary or export the full response.
correctness.after: The UI computes dr24-raw-qc-v0.1 counts from the unmodified epoch array, retains every epoch, and exports the raw API payload with the QC summary as ztf-dr24-raw-export-v0.1. Browser validation is pending.

reproducibility.before: Raw payload hashes and acquisition provenance were visible in the UI, but there was no downloadable combined raw/QC artifact.
reproducibility.after: The JSON export contains the complete source payload, acquisition provenance, payload/schema hashes, descriptive QC, export schema version and export timestamp. Browser validation is pending.

reliability.before: The export path did not exist.
reliability.after: The export button is disabled until a successful source response, and it is disabled after missing-OID or source-failure responses. Browser validation is pending.

scientific_validity.reason: The QC is descriptive only. It defines no threshold, quality mask, epoch rejection, normalization, identity grouping or model inference.

measurement.trade_off: A client-side descriptive QC summary is used for the raw Explorer. It does not replace a versioned scientific QC selection policy or a server-side validated normalization contract.

evidence: UI implementation added in src/ztf_classifier/web/static/app.js on the PR #267 branch and synchronized to PR #272.
QC contract version is dr24-raw-qc-v0.1. Export schema version is ztf-dr24-raw-export-v0.1.

The QC records finite HMJD/mag/magerr counts; magerr sign counts; catflags valid/missing/invalid counts; bit-15 counts; strict catflags==0 count; other nonzero flags; epochs_excluded=0; filtering_applied=false.
Browser run 42235753856 is pending. It must verify all seven OIDs, synthetic null-catflags behavior, JSON export content, and disabled export behavior after missing/failing requests.

unresolved: Complete the live browser run and inspect the export artifact.
Confirm that the export contains every raw epoch and preserves source values and provenance.
Confirm that QC counts agree with the raw epochs and the plotted flag counts.
Confirm that no quality mask or epoch exclusion is applied.
The QC contract is descriptive only and does not establish a production acceptance policy.

findings: Descriptive raw QC must remain separate from quality-selection policy.
The export must preserve the raw response and add diagnostics without modifying source records.
An export must remain disabled when the source response is missing or fails.
Missing and invalid catflags must remain distinct from valid zero flags.

open_blockers: Pass the browser test for all seven OIDs and inspect the artifact.
Pass the synthetic null-catflags QC test.
Pass the JSON export test and verify the exported payload hash/provenance.
Verify export is disabled for missing-OID and source-failure responses.
Add independent payload-hash references for the three candidate OIDs without them.
Complete the 5–10 source-target application acceptance test and 30–50 source-target Park demo.

knowledge_carried_forward: dr24-raw-qc-v0.1 is descriptive only; it does not filter or reject epochs.
ztf-dr24-raw-export-v0.1 preserves the raw API response and adds the QC summary.
No QC threshold, mask, or normalization is approved by this change.
Keep DR24 raw exploration separate from frozen v0.2.0 inference.
